environment.description: Same Node.js Apollo GraphQL server deployed in namespace 'api-services' on EKS 1.28. A Cilium-based NetworkPolicy is applied at the cluster level via a CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy resource named 'deny-metadata-egress'. The policy spec uses endpointSelector matching pods with label app.kubernetes.io/part-of=api-stack and egressDeny rules targeting CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 on port 80 (HTTP). Additionally, a separate CiliumNetworkPolicy in the namespace applies toEndpoints matching the pod's specific label (app=graphql-server) with an egress rule that only allows DNS (port 53 to kube-dns) and HTTPS to specific service mesh endpoints. The deny rule takes precedence per Cilium's policy enforcement model where deny policies override allow policies. Note: IMDSv1 is still enabled on the node, and the pod SA still has the IAM role attached.
